content: The 4% formulation is provided in 45-gram tubes (NDC 50458-535-01) equipped with an ORTHO 1 Measured-Dose Applicator. It should be stored at a controlled room temperature of 15–30°C (59–86°F). The 8% formulation is available in 20-gram tubes (NDC 50458-536-01) also equipped with an ORTHO 1 Measured-Dose Applicator. It must be stored at a controlled room temperature of 15–30°C (59–86°F). The 5-gram suppositories, which are elliptically shaped and range in color from white to off-white, are packaged in sets of three (NDC 50458-531-01) and come with a vaginal applicator. These should also be stored at a controlled room temperature of 15–30°C (59–86°F).
